description: Two editions of the Traffic Accommodation Manual describe minimum traffic-control standards for construction zones on Alberta provincial highways. The source establishes safe and efficient traffic flow, temporary signing and party responsibilities as the subject. Each edition has a PDF manual and a ZIP of typical drawings; the description identifies DGN drawings within the package. The 2018 source calls itself the second edition. Editions remain separate components of one manual family, with no claim that individual controls or drawings are unchanged. No capacity equations, traffic model, road geometry or executable software are established. Current legal applicability of these dated standards is unverified. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves source identifiers and descriptive metadata. Provider: Government of Alberta; Transportation. Licence: Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs and current file access are unverified. Access metadata says unrestricted; isopen is false. No linked dataset, workbook, document, archive or model/code body was retrieved. Specific simulation applications beyond the stated role are unknown. Related source components retain their own identities. Geographic coverage is Alberta.
